summary: App UI changes for VAT/invoicing: reorganize Service Product category placement, adjust column sizing/layout, and improve VAT Category selection UX (limited visible items with scrolling).

existing_features.title: Move the “Service/Product Category” field out of the Results flow and into the Invoice step: remove the Service/Product Category selector from the VAT calculator Transaction/Results UI and add it under the Invoice tab/step, positioned before the item description field/column.
Reduce the visual size (compact the layout) of the “Enable Reverse Charge” and “VAT Treatment” UI controls so they take less space, especially on desktop/tablet widths.
Reposition the “VAT Category” control to the right side of the “Transaction Details” section layout (i.e., right column on md+ breakpoints), while keeping a sensible stacked layout on mobile.
Update the VAT Category dropdown so that only 5 VAT Category options are visible at once, with vertical scrolling enabled to reach the remaining categories.

new_feature_requests.summary: Move 'Service Product category' from Results tab to Invoice tab, positioned before the Description column.
Reduce box size (column width) for 'Enable Reverse charge' and 'VAT Treatment' columns.
Reposition 'VAT Category' to the right side of Transaction Details.
Limit VAT Category selector to show 5 visible items with scrolling to select the correct VAT Category.

projectName: Reorganize VAT calculator UI: move Service/Product Category to Invoice step, compact controls, and improve VAT Category selector
